hardware_validation: Authorized trial-led-pair-20261105 on MU3356 board 4: sources [0,4] -> [3,4] -> [0,4] through real RPC jobs, peer-only changes preserved WAN uptime. DSDS on plus explicit enable confirmed CFUN [1,1]; DSDS off restored [0,1]; single-standby mutual exclusion [1,0], both-off [0,0] and original restore [0,1] passed. IPv4/IPv6 ping each 3/3 before and after RF tests. Actual SIM/LED web views and mobile layouts passed. PMIC white channel registration, brightness and exclusive colour readback passed, but user did not inspect real colours/boot animation. NV writeback off and storage read-only throughout. Normal return to stock Android A completed, original selected card/DSDS/mux confirmed. Two real external cards, OTG and NFC remain unaccepted; not a blanket acceptance for other boards. RF caption follow-up is source/browser tested after Android return, not deployed.

stock_initial_standby.import_policy: Import actual Android card sources on a fresh install. OpenWrt dual_standby defaults off as requested; preserve existing explicit OpenWrt source/RF preferences.
